gates.name: judge_facts
gates.detail: factual risk 4/10: A 20% drop in price can instantly wipe out 100% of your wealth. (It only wipes out 100% of your equity in that specific asset, not your entire net worth, unless you are 100% concentrated).; If your total debt is more than 80% of the asset's value, you're in danger. (An 80% LTV is standard for conventional mortgages and not an automatic state of danger; this is an arbitrary, alarmist threshold).
